summary: Type hints label what types a variable, parameter, or return value should have. Generic classes like Box[T] work with any type while keeping the hints accurate.
notes: class Box[T]: is Python 3.12 syntax. Older code writes T = TypeVar("T") and class Box(Generic[T]).
def first_item[T](items: list[T]) -> T says the return value has the same type as the list's items.
Box[str](404) runs with no error. Hints are only checked by a separate tool such as mypy.
pitfall: Assuming a hint like scores: list[float] will stop bad data. Python runs the code anyway, so a wrong type fails later with an error like TypeError: unsupported operand type(s).
